title: Palo Alto NGFW or Check Point: Choosing Between Two Long-Standing Firewall Leaders
excerpt: Both vendors are long-established in enterprise firewalls. This comparison focuses on what tends to decide the purchase: intrusion prevention heritage, how licensing works and how strongly each is investing in cloud security.
verdict: Palo Alto has the clearer cloud strategy and a licensing model most teams find easier to follow. Check Point remains a sound choice, particularly for teams that have built years of in-house expertise around it, where switching would cost more than it saves.
